newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian upper house likely debate 97 budget Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: Russian upper house likely debate 97 budget Feb 12.

text.p: Russia's Federation Council upper house of parliament will probably discuss the 1997 draft budget at its next session on February 12, a spokeswoman for the Council said on Monday.
"As of now the next sitting is scheduled for February 12," she told Reuters. "I think the budget will be discussed then."
The budget envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of Gross Domestic Product, by Russian calculations, on revenues of 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditures of 529.8 trillion roubles.
The State Duma lower house of parliament approved the draft at a fourth final reading on Friday. The draft then passes to the Federation Council for consideration.
It also requires approval by President Boris Yeltsin before becoming law.
